text:
Alex: Morning checklist: umbrella ✅, soggy shoes ❌. Muni 24 stopped on 16th due to standing water. anyone else stuck? :umbrella:
Priya: Same. Bus rolled by but driver told us can't pass flooded blocks. Took an Uber but it's chaos. :sweat_smile:
Jamal: BART moving slow too, speed restrictions on the peninsula. recommend leaving extra 20-30m.
transitbot: [Transit Alert] Muni 24 delayed, standing water reported at 16th St & Mission. ETA impacts: +18-25m. More info: https://status.sfmta.org/alerts/12345
Lily: Thanks @transitbot — adding 30m buffer to my calendar. Can someone pick up a spare umbrella for the office? mine betrayed me. :pleading_face:
Dave: I have an extra in desk 4B, come grab. Also gonna bring a thermos of coffee for anyone cold/wet in 20 mins. :coffee:
Priya: Legend. also: meme
Alex: [Alex posts GIF: person sailing in office chair through puddle] :joy:
Jamal: PSA: if you bike, avoid the underpass on King St. I almost lost a pedal.
Lily: Office ETA: 10:20. will be dripping in, sorry for squeaky footsteps.
Dave: For folks remote, standup moved to 10:45 to let folks arrive. CC @everyone
Priya: Thanks! Also, shoutout to facilities for those paper towels in the lobby. small win. :raised_hands:
Alex: Agree — facilities rock. See you all (dry?) soon.
